title.narrative: Fiscal Management Enhancement Project for the State of Mato Grosso do Sul PROFISCO II-MS
Proyecto de Modernizacin de la Gestin Fiscal del Estado de Mato Grosso do Sul PROFISCO II-MS

description.narrative: El objetivo del proyecto es contribuir a la sostenibilidad fiscal del Estado a travsde: (i) la modernizacin de la gestin hacendaria; (ii) la mejora de la Administracin Tributaria (AT); y (iii) la mejora dela gestin del gasto pblico.El presente proyecto es la sexta operacin individual de prstamo bajo la CCLIP PROFISCO II (BR-X1039) aprobadapor el Directorio Ejecutivo mediante Resolucin DE-11317.

The project objective is to contribute to the state's fiscal sustainability through: (i) modernization of fiscal management; (ii) improvement of tax administration; and (iii) improvement of public expenditure management.This project is the sixth individual loan operation under the PROFISCO II CCLIP (BR-X1039) approved by the Board of Executive Directors through Resolution DE-11317.
